turns.question: What was our CPA on search in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no CPA metric; its closest are cost per booking (the cost per conversion), 124.84 EUR per booking, and cost per lead, 42.07 EUR per lead, both on the search channel over 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
